description: Every 3CX Configuration API (XAPI) object in one Go binary, with a local mirror of your whole PBX, offline search, config diffing, and cross-entity auditing no 3CX tool has.

novel_features.name: Config integrity audit
novel_features.description: Flag every ring group, queue, inbound/outbound rule, and IVR destination that points at a deleted, disabled, or non-existent extension or DID.

novel_features.name: Config snapshot and diff
novel_features.description: Capture the full PBX config to a local snapshot, then show exactly what changed between two points in time or two tenants.

novel_features.name: Bulk provision from CSV
novel_features.description: Idempotently create extensions and users from a CSV, assigning groups and roles, with a dry-run plan and typed exit codes.

novel_features.name: Queue and agent performance rollup
novel_features.description: One cross-queue table joining queue performance, agent-in-queue stats, abandoned calls, and SLA breaches over a time window.

novel_features.name: Offline directory search
novel_features.description: Instant full-text search across the mirrored config graph (users, groups, ring groups, queues, trunks, DIDs, contacts) by number, name, email, or extension.

novel_features.name: Security posture report
novel_features.description: Consolidate blocklist, blacklisted numbers, anti-hacking settings, firewall state, failed-auth events, and the admin audit log into one attack-surface report.

novel_features.name: Extension routing trace
novel_features.description: For one extension, show every inbound rule, ring group, queue, DID, and forwarding profile that routes to it.

novel_features.name: Live state merge
novel_features.description: A single time-windowed feed merging activity log, event log, active calls, and system status into the state of the PBX now or since a given time.
